comments.body: Speak to the Trainer NPC in a EU player capital city (Seville, Lisbon, London, Amsterdam, Marseilles or Venice). Pet deeds from completed pet quests can be obtained from the Trainer NPC and equipped/de-equipped there as well. For info on pet skills/feeding, click on the pet deed link. Cheers.
